create_MLP_basic: create an MLP with layer sizes [1, 2, 3] and call it with a tensor input
create_MLP_with_bias: create an MLP with with_bias=False to disable bias in all linear layers
create_MLP_with_activation: create an MLP with a custom activation function applied between layers
create_MLP_activate_final: create an MLP with activate_final=True to apply activation on the last layer
create_MLP_with_dropout: create an MLP with dropout_rate=0.5 and call it passing is_training=True
